movers.text: Captain Aleksander Barkov (knee, out since Oct. 1) and Brad Marchand (knee) are returning vs OTT tonight, the Panthers said Wednesday morning.
D Cale Makar (22.4 TOI, lower body, out since 11/12) practiced fully and hopes to return vs MTL tonight, decision after the morning skate; C Nathan MacKinnon is out about 12 weeks.
C Connor Bedard (20.1 TOI) had shoulder surgery and is out about four months, the Blackhawks said 11/24; D Wyatt Kaiser (19.3) is serving a 3-game suspension and D Bowen Byram is out.
No. 1 D Quinn Hughes (27.8 TOI, upper body) is on injured reserve (placed 11/23) and expected to miss Wednesday vs UTAH.
C Elias Pettersson (18.7 TOI, upper body) is ruled out for the rest of the road trip, including tonight at DET, and is expected out until at least early December.
